name: Missing ~Itsuka Kitto~
source:
On the White Day February 14th Yuuki Masahiro received a bar of chocolate in the post. The next year he also gains a bar of chocolate and a message only saying "Missing". From that moment events starts to whirl around him.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
白色情人节那天，2月14日，优纪正弘收到了一块邮寄来的巧克力。第二年，他又收到一块巧克力，以及一条只有“Missing”的留言。从那一刻起，事件开始在他身边急速旋转。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
